summary: This note is a short biography of Tom Denney, an American musician from Ocala, Florida, born November 23, 1982. It states that he is a founding member and former lead guitarist of the band A Day to Remember, and that he has since left the band and now works as a producer at his own recording studio.
one_line: Tom Denney is an American musician from Ocala, Florida, and a founding member and former lead guitarist of A Day to Remember.
key_facts: Tom Denney was born on November 23, 1982.
Tom Denney is an American musician from Ocala, Florida.
Tom Denney is a founding member of A Day to Remember.
Tom Denney is the ex-lead guitarist of A Day to Remember.
Tom Denney has parted ways with A Day to Remember.
Tom Denney now produces music at his own recording studio.
